answer: To prevent agents that wander across identity-spaces from spoofing, our model utilizes a lotus-shaped network where each node possesses a walnut shell of recursive zero-knowledge reputation commitments. These commitments, paired with staking collateral subject to slashing penalties, enforce negative expected utility for cloning. Integrating sequential zero-knowledge verifiable delay functions ensures spoofing costs exceed any payoff, establishing a robust Nash equilibrium where honesty remains the only viable strategy.
